newsitem.title: FRANCE: Analysts upgrade Alcatel after meeting.
newsitem.headline: Analysts upgrade Alcatel after meeting.

text.p: Financial analysts are upgrading 1997 and 1998 profit forecasts for Alcatel Alsthom after a meeting on the 1996 results, brokers and analysts said.

Some of the analysts are now pencilling in a 1998 net profit of eight billion francs, or 50 francs per share, against a consensus before Tuesday's result of 41.9 francs for 1998 after 27.30 francs for 1997.

"What counts is 1998 and there the outlook is exceptional," one analyst said, noting chairman Serge Tchuruk had mentioned a profitability of eight to 10 percent, without detailing when that would be reached.
"Tchuruk presented Alcatel Alsthom as an Internet (related) stock, which pleased investors who had not thought about that before," another analyst said.
